data.title: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884

thumbnail.alt_text: Painting of a park on an island with people relaxing in the shade.

data.description:
Georges Seurat painted A Sunday on La Grande Jatte using a technique called pointillism & color theory.

It took him two years.
